card.name: Prepositions after comply, based, adhere
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after a verb or participle that needs one, such as "comply with", "based on", "adhere to" and "resulted in". Also fires on "ine" in "alkaline phosphatase".

modes.description: The preposition that completes comply with, based on, adhere to or resulted in.
